Name: Barcelona-Sants station
Tips: 09:45-10:00 drive in and RETURN THE CAR TO SIXT in the SABA car park, LEVEL -1 (open from 07:00), then take the lift straight up into the station. FUEL IT FIRST - Sixt charges well above pump price; stations on Carrer de Tarragona and around Plaça d Espanya, build in 10 min. PHOTOGRAPH THE CAR AND FUEL GAUGE at drop-off. Then security scan, platform screen (Coche 6 is roughly mid-platform), at the gate 10:30 latest. THE ONLY HARD WALL: Renfe closes train access 2 MINUTES BEFORE departure, so be past security by ~10:45. Fallback if the car went wrong: taxi ~12-15 EUR, ~15 min.
